description: An engineering manager must approve the production data-handling and cost-control policy for a new event-telemetry pipeline, including sampling, retention, redaction, raw-payload storage, and monitoring, with input from security engineering and the platform finance owner.

shared_context.S1: The new event-telemetry pipeline passed its functional and load tests in staging.
shared_context.S2: The current draft policy enables production collection at 100 percent sampling, retains data for 30 days, and stores raw event payloads.
shared_context.S3: Maya makes the binding decision before the pipeline's production enablement.
shared_context.S4: The go-live checklist requires Maya to ask the security and platform finance owners to confirm data-handling and operating-cost requirements before the policy is locked.

PF1.text: During an unrelated privacy review this morning, Ravi confirmed that the production events contain the fields tax_id and bank_account in three event types. The approved data-handling rule requires both fields to be redacted before storage, requires raw payload storage to be disabled, and requires production telemetry to remain enabled once those controls are applied; he has not filed the finding in the launch ticket yet.

PF2.text: While reconciling the platform invoice ten minutes ago, Clara found that the production payload volume is expected to cost four times the draft estimate. The approved operating budget supports exactly 25 percent sampling and exactly 14 days of retention, and a cost alert must be enabled; she has not updated the cost worksheet yet.

acceptance_conditions: Sampling must be set to exactly 25 percent.
Retention must be set to exactly 14 days.
The tax_id and bank_account fields must both be redacted.
Raw event payload storage must be disabled.
A cost alert must be enabled.
A commitment to implement the required redaction must exist.
A commitment to configure the telemetry cost alert must exist.
The security finding must be cited as justification and must have been stated aloud by its owner.

content_checks.C7: any(c['target'] == 'Ravi' and 'launch ticket' in c['detail'] for c in commitments)
content_checks.C8: any(c['target'] == 'Clara' and 'cost worksheet' in c['detail'] for c in commitments)

decisive_facts.why: The draft policy's staging status does not establish the production decision; PF1 changes production logging to enabled once the required tax_id and bank_account redaction and raw-storage controls are applied, while also supplying the security fact that must be cited.

The draft uses 100 percent sampling and 30 days of retention with no cost control; PF2 changes those settings to exactly 25 percent and 14 days, enables the cost alert, and requires the cost worksheet update commitment.
